newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenian copper/molybdenum plant reopens March 1.
newsitem.headline: Armenian copper/molybdenum plant reopens March 1.

text.p: Armenia's state-owned copper and molybdenum processing plant will reopen on March 1 after a three-month shutdown for repairs, an Industry Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.

Sergei Ovakimyan said that the Zangezur Copper-Molybdenum Plant, located 150 km northeast of the capital Yerevan, planned to produce 3,400 tonnes of molybdenum concentrate and 5,000 tonnes of copper concentrate in 1997.

The plant turned out 3,116 tonnes of molybdenum concentrate and 4,483 tonnes of copper concentrate in 1996, of which about 90 percent was exported to neighboring Iran. Ores used in processing are obtained from local mines.
